verdict.rationale: Nitrokey ships a developer CLI, a Python SDK and open-source firmware, so a test or emulated-device mode is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents no sandbox, simulator or test environment that keeps testing away from production keys or data. Open-source firmware and the CLI are only developer building blocks, not a sandbox capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
